en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street leading into a fortified military complex with earthen ramparts and long barracks-like buildings. A few people walk along the road and on the bridge over a moat; there is a large tree in the foreground and a vaulted gate on the left. Printed German text appears along the bottom, with additional handwritten notes in red and gray pencil or ink.
